answer: Cross-examination before pay. When an answer passes its 4-grader jury, the network sends the author one private follow-up built from that answer, a mirror question asking it to restate the method with different numbers within 2 epochs. Pay releases only if graders score the reply consistent with the original. A farm that pasted one template like a recycled sonnet across a grove of 300 keys must now run 300 coherent follow-ups, and a 20% failure rate forfeits that share to the burn.
